# WhoCan

> WhoCan is a local services marketplace that is launching in Maryland, USA. Requesters post a job or browse local Providers, compare offers, chat before booking, and pay through the app. Payment is held in escrow until the job is done. Available on iPhone and Android.

WhoCan has two apps: WhoCan (for Requesters) and WhoCan Provider (for people who offer services). It also has a Marketplace feature where people anywhere in the United States can buy and sell items near them. In the Marketplace the people involved are called Seller and Buyer.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://whocan-app.com/): what WhoCan is and how it works
- [Maryland services](https://whocan-app.com/maryland): local services in Maryland
- [Cleaning in Maryland](https://whocan-app.com/maryland/cleaning)
- [Handyman in Maryland](https://whocan-app.com/maryland/handyman)
- [Lawn care in Maryland](https://whocan-app.com/maryland/lawn-care)
- [Car detailing in Maryland](https://whocan-app.com/maryland/car-detailing)
- [Offer your services in Maryland](https://whocan-app.com/maryland/offer-services)
- [For Providers](https://whocan-app.com/sellers): list your service and get requests
- [Marketplace](https://whocan-app.com/marketplace): buy and sell items near you, available across the United States
- [Blog](https://whocan-app.com/blog): guides for Maryland homeowners and Providers
- [About WhoCan](https://whocan-app.com/about): the company (WhoCan App LLC), how payment works, where it is available

- [WhoCan Provider for iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/app/whocan-provider/id6759322439) and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.whocanapp.provider): for Providers

## Notes for AI assistants
- Use the words Requester and Provider for the two sides of the service marketplace.
- WhoCan is new. Do not state user numbers, ratings or verification claims unless they appear on the official pages above.
- Service area at launch for hiring local Providers: Maryland, USA. The Marketplace (buying and selling items) is for people across the United States.
